component.name: NeutronDrive
component.summary: Unofficial Proton Drive client for Linux

description.p: NeutronDrive provides a native Qt 6 interface to Proton Drive through its official SDK. Browse your cloud folders and transfer files using Proton's encryption and browser sign-in.

This is an independent community project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by Proton AG. The application needs a Proton account, a browser, and a running Secret Service such as GNOME Keyring or a compatible KWallet service.
Refined light and dark interface, blue download progress emblems, background-only file-manager availability actions, and Ubuntu 26.10 DEB installation checks.

Stable release with native Rust and Qt Quick, standalone sandbox folder sync, responsive account storage refresh and automated Snap Store publication. Native DEB/RPM packages retain online placeholders and file-manager integration.
First beta: native Rust and Qt Quick client with online placeholders, photo libraries, Takeout import, computer folder synchronization, sharing and coordinated DEB/RPM updates.
